target: Exact common A-space, active Green factorization, uniform inactive source estimate, and continuum spectral projection identification
acceptedPartialResults: The abstract Hilbert-space spectral tail estimate and Riesz-projection continuity theorem are valid once their hypotheses hold.
The synchronized endpoint coefficient perturbation is far inside the finite collocation Krawczyk capacity.
The active Green/Lagrange factorization theorem is valid conditional on an exact endpoint BVP solution with the stated bounds.

finite collocation solve implies enclosure of the exact ODE flow

exactVolterraFormClosability.label: closability of the exact endpoint-B Volterra form
exactVolterraFormClosability.reason: The exact endpoint-B kernel is continuous and Hilbert--Schmidt; its bounded form and every dense-core restriction are closable.

exactVolterraFormNonnegativity.label: nonnegativity of the exact Volterra form on the closed-trace core
exactVolterraFormNonnegativity.reason: An outward-rounded endpoint-B kernel direction supported strictly outside the trace interval has a negative quadratic form. Smooth mollification gives f in N_0 with a_B[f]<0.
exactVolterraFormNonnegativity.requiredProof: The present obligation cannot be proved: reformulate the form, trace, or domain to exclude the certified exterior negative direction.

endpointExactFlow.label: exact endpoint fundamental flow and active singular-value bound
endpointExactFlow.reason: The exact coefficient disks, continuous local residual/tail inclusions, independently reset induced-flow transitions, and weighted global BVP Krawczyk self-map close. The endpoint balls contain both columns of I_2, proving the stronger right-inverse claim.

compactLipschitzSource.label: compact and Lipschitz continuum source operator in H_A
compactLipschitzSource.reason: The proposed positive A-Hilbert space is unavailable because its defining endpoint-B form is negative on N_0.
compactLipschitzSource.requiredProof: Prove the special source-row estimate ||E_u f||^2<=eta(u)a[f] on ker R with locally bounded eta, and prove the corresponding representers are norm-Lipschitz in u.

galerkinQDelta.label: Galerkin-to-continuum identification of Q_delta
galerkinQDelta.reason: The continuum A-space and its Q_delta projection are not defined on the stated model after the defining form is refuted.
galerkinQDelta.requiredProof: Prove Mosco convergence of the actual closed-trace high blocks and operator-norm convergence of the compact source compressions; then apply Riesz-projection continuity across a certified spectral gap.
